text.body:
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ |
atha śrīdakṣiṇakālīkāpūjāprayogaḥ |
jalapātraṃ kare kṛtvā pūjā dvāri gatvā | oṃ vajrodake hūṁ phaṭ svāhā | ityanena jalamadhiṣṭhāya tatrāsanamāstīrya phaṭ ityāsanamabhyukṣa tatropaviśya | oṃ hrīṁ viśuddhasarvapāpaniśamayā śeṣavikalpamapanaya hūṁ | ityanena hastau pādau ca prakṣālya hrīṁ ācamena oṃ hrīṃ svāhā | iti trirjalaṃ pītvā | oṃ iti oṣṭhau dvirunmṛjya hrīṁ iti hastau prakṣālya hrīṁ ityanena mukhanāsikādvaya karṇadvaya nābhihṛdaya śiraḥ skandhadvayeṣu tatvamudrayā spṛśediti dvirācamya | oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare rakṣa rakṣa hūṁ phaṭ svāhā | ityena śikhāṃ vadhnīyāt | vastrāṃcale vā graṃthi vadhniyāt | tato mantrācamanaṃ kuryāt | klīṁ svāhā | iti trijalaṃ pibet | krīṁ kālyai namaḥ | krīṁ kapālinyai namaḥ | iti dauṣṭau dvirunmṛjet | krīṁ kullāyai namaḥ | iti hastau kṣālayet | oṃ rakṣa (2) hūṁ phaṭ svāhā | iti bhūmi saṃśodhya |
oṃ pavitravajrabhūme hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ svāhā | iti vāmapādena bhūmiṃ saṃtāḍya caturdikṣu maṃḍalaṃ pūjayet | oṃ vāstvīśāya namaḥ | oṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ | oṃ sarvavighnānutsāraya hūṁ phaṭ svāhā | tataḥ maṃtraṃ japet | oṃ glūṁ slūṁ plūṁ gāṁ gaṇapataye namaḥ | tataḥ saṃvitsādhanaṃ kuryāt |
atha saṃvitsodhanaṃ |
oṃ āsurekhe vajrarekhe hūṁ phaṭ svāhā | ityanena caturdikṣumaṃḍalaṃ kṛtvā | tataḥ viniyogaṃ kuryāt |
oṃ asya śrīsaṃvido'sya maṃtrasya dakṣiṇāmūrti ṛṣipaṃktichandaḥ sadāśivo devatā saṃvitsānnidhyāropaṇe viniyogaḥ |
atha dhyāne tu |
siddhādyāṃ śivamohinīṃ karalasatpāśāṃkuśāṃ bhairavīṃ bhaktābhīṣṭaphalapradāsu kuśalāṃ saṃsāravaṃdha chidā || pīyūṣāmbudhimanthanodbhavarasāṃ saṃvidvilāsāspadaṃ vīrārādhitapādukāṃ suvijayāṃ dhyāyejjaganmohinīṃ |||
iti dhyātvā pratyekaṃ śodhayedyathā |
oṃ saṃvide brahmasaṃbhūte brahmaputri sadānaghe | bhairavānāṃ ca tṛptyarthaṃ pavitrī bhava sarvadā ||
oṃ brāhmaṇyai namaḥ svāhā || 1 ||
oṃ siddhimūlikriye devi hīnabodha prabodhini | rājaprajāvaśakari śatrukaṇṭhatriśūlini ||
aiṁ kṣatriyāyai namaḥ svāhā || 2 ||
oṃ ajñānendhana dīptāgne jñānāgne jñānarūpiṇī | ānandasyāhutiṃ matvā samyag jñānaṃ prayaccha me ||
hrīṁ vaiśyāyai namaḥ svāhā || 3 ||
oṃ namasyāmi namasyāmi yogamārgapradarśini | trailokya vijaye mātaḥ samādhikūladā bhava ||
klīṁ śūdrāyai namaḥ svāhā || 4 ||
tato hrīṁ śrīṁ aiṁ amṛte amṛtodbhave amṛtavarṣiṇi mahatprakāśayukte amṛtaṃ śrāvaya (2) śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikāṃ me vaśamānaya svāhā | phaṭ iti saṃprokṣa | hūṁ iti avaguṃṭhya | vaṁ dhenumudrayā'mṛtīkṛtya | mūlena yonimudrayā sandīpya ṣaḍaṃga maṃtraiḥ sakalīkṛtya matsyamudrayā āchādya | tatra mūlamaṃtraṃ daśadhā japediti | jātibhedo jñānena hrīṁ śrīṁ aiṁ amṛte amṛtodbhave ityādi maṃtreṇa śodhayet | tatastarpaṇaṃ kuryāt | aiṁ hrīṁ
śrīṁ amukānandanātha amukī devyaṃbā śrīpādukāṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ | iti śirasi trivāraṃ saṃtarpya | aiṁ śrīṁ gurūṃstarpayāmi namaḥ | aiṁ paramagurūṃstarpayāmi namaḥ | aiṁ parāpara gurūṃstarpayāmi namaḥ | oṃ parameṣṭhigurūṃstarpayāmi namaḥ | iti śirasi sakṛtsakṛt tarpayitvā tato hṛdi mūlamuccāryya | śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikāṃ tarpayāmi svāhā | iti triḥsaṃtarpya mahākālamantramuccāryya śrīmanmahākālabhairavaṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ | iti triḥ saṃtarpyamūlamuccārya sāyudhā savāhanāṃ saparivārāṃ śrīmanmahākālabhairavasahitāṃ śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikāṃ tarpayāmi svāhā | iti triḥ saṃtarpya vāmahasta tatvamudrayā vijayā pātraṃ dhṛtvā | dakṣiṇena jalaṃ gṛhītvā mūlamuccārya | eṣa vijayā śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikāyai nivedayāmi | iti nivedya | yathāśakti mūlamaṃtraṃ japtvā samarpya praṇamya tatrastha śaktivīrebhya pariveśya svīyapātre nītvā dhyātvā stutvā namaskṛtya | kuṃ
(FOḻīO ṇO. 3 īṣ ṃīṣṣīṇṅ)
phaṭ iti arghapātraṃ prakṣāla namaḥ | iti ādhāroparisaṃsthāpya | aṃ arkamaṃḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ | ityarghapātraṃ saṃpūjya namaḥ | iti jalenāpūrya | uṃ somamaṃḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ | iti jalaṃ saṃpūjya |
oṃ gaṃge ca yamune caiva goḍāvarī sarasvatī | narmade sindhu kāveri jalesmin sannidhiṃ kuru ||
ehi gaṃge namastubhyaṃ sarvatīrthasamanvite | brahmāṇḍodara tīrthāni karapṛṣṭhāni te rave ||
tena satyena te devi tīrthaṃ dehi divākara |
ityanenāṃkuśamudrayā tatra tīrthānyābāhya | oṃ iti gandhapuṣpabilvapatradurvākṣatān datvā hūṁ ityavaguṃṭhya vaṃ dhenumudrayā amṛtīkṛtya matsyamudrayā āchādya | tatra oṃ iti daśadhā japediti sāmānyārghyaṃ | tenodakena dvāramabhyukṣya dvāradevatāḥ pūjayet | yathā dvārorddhe ete gaṃdhapuṣpe gāṃ gaṇeśāya namaḥ | vāme kṣāṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ | dakṣiṇe vāṃ vaṭukāya namaḥ | adho yāṃ yoginībhyo namaḥ | vāmorddhakoṇe gāṃ gaṃgāyai namaḥ | tathā dakṣiṇe yāṃ yamunāyai namaḥ |
vāmādhaḥ koṇe śrīlakṣmyai namaḥ | tathā dakṣiṇe aiṁ sarasvatyai namaḥ | dehalyāṃ oṃ astrāya namaḥ | iti gandhapuṣpavāribhiḥ sarvatra pūjayet | tato vāmāṃgaṃ saṃkocayana dakṣiṇapāda puraḥsaraṃ dakṣiṇaśākhāṃ spṛśan maṇḍapāntaḥ praviśya | nai(-)ṛtyā
apasarvaṃtu te bhūtā ye bhūtā bhuvi saṃsthitāḥ | ye bhūtā vighnakartāraste naśyaṃ tu śivājñayā ||
iti maṃtrābhyāṃ digvidikṣu vikīrya phaṭ iti urddhvorddha tālatrayaṃ datvā mūlamuccārya astrāya phaṭ iti jalenāṃtarīkṣa tān vighnānutsārya phaṭ iti vāmapādapārṣṇirghātatrayena bhaumān vighānutsārya | tatra trikoṇamaṃḍalaṃ vilikhya | ete gaṃdhapuṣpe | hrīṁ ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ | iti maṃḍalaṃ saṃpūjya | tatra vihitāsanamāstīrya | tatra hsauḥ bījaṃ vilikhya | tatra dūrvā trayaṃ datvāsanaṃ śodhayet | kṛtāṃjaliḥ āsanaṃ dhṛtvā asyāsana mantrasya merupṛṣṭha ṛṣiḥ sutalaṃ chandaḥ kūrmodevatā āsanāropaṇe viniyogaḥ |
oṃ pṛthvi tvayā dhṛtā lokā devitvaṃ viṣṇunā dhṛtā |
tvaṃ ca dhāraya māṃ nityaṃ pavitraṃ kuru cāsanaṃ ||
iti paṭhitvā ete gandhapuṣpe hsauṁḥ ādhāraśakti kamalāsanāya namaḥ | ityāsanaṃ saṃpūjya |
tatra kuśapatratrayaṃ datvā sāmānyārghyaṃ saṃsthāpya tenodakenātmānaṃ pūjopakaraṇānyabhyukṣya punarmūlena pūjādravyāṇi saṃprokṣya puṣpāṇi śodhayet | śatābhiṣeka samaya priye samāśraye śatābhiṣeka hūṁ phaṭ svāhā | ityanena puṣpamadhiṣṭhāya | oṃ puṣpaketu rājārhate śatāya samyak saṃbandhāya hūṁ puṣpe (2) mahāpuṣpe supuṣpe puṣpasaṃbhave puṣpasaṃcayāvasaṃkīrṇe hūṁ phaṭ svāhā | iti puṣpamabhimaṃtramūlānte phaṭ | iti pūjādravyāṇi saṃprokṣya | vaṁ dhenumudrayā amṛtī kuryāt | tato gandhapuṣpākṣatābhyāṃ karau saṃśodhya hūṁ phaṭ svāhā | iti tat puṣpanai(-)ṛtyāṃ nikṣipya phaṭ iti | urddhvorddhatālatrayaṃ datvā phaṭ iti choṭikābhirdaśadigbaṃdhanaṃ kṛtvā | raṃ iti digvidikṣu jaladhārāṃ veṣṭayitvā vahneḥ prākāraṃ vicintya prāṇāyāmaṃ kuryād yathā dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhena
dakṣanāsikāṃ dhṛtvā | krīṁ iti ṣoḍaśavāraṃ japan vāmanāsayā vāyumāpūryya aṃguṣṭhānāmākaniṣṭhābhiḥ ubhaya nāsikāṃ dhṛtvā | tasya catuḥṣaṣṭhivāraṃ japan vāyuṃ kuṃbhakaṃ kṛtvā | tasya dvātriṃśadvāraṃ japan dakṣanāsāyā vāyuṃ recayet | punaḥ pūrvavaddakṣanāsāyā vāyumāpūrya kuṃbhakaṃ kṛtvā | vāmanāsāyā vāyuṃ recayet | punaḥ pūrvavadvāmanāsayā vāyumāpūryakuṃbhakaṃ kṛtvā dakṣanāsayā vāyuṃ recayet | etadaśaktaścet caturvāra japena vāyumāpūrya ṣoḍaśavārajapena kuṃbhakaṃ kṛtvā aṣṭavārajapena vāyuṃ recayet | iti prāṇāyāmaḥ |
ata bhūtaśuddhiṃ kuryāt | svāṃke uttāna karau kṛtvā nayananimīlyamantreṇa hṛdayādīpakalikāraṃ jīvātmānaṃ mūlādhārastha kuṃḍalinyā saha mūlādhāra svādhiṣṭhānamaṇipūra anāhata viśuddhājñākhya ṣaṭcakrāṇi bhitvā śiraḥstha sahasradalakamale yasya śive saṃyojya tatraiva pṛthivyaptejo vāyvākāśarūparasagandhasparśaśabdānāsikājihvācakṣustvakśrotra vākpāṇipādapāyupaśca
prakṛti manobuddhi ahaṃkārarūpa caturviṃśati tatvāni līnāni vibhāvya śuddha saccinmayo bhūtvā ||
vāmakukṣi sthitaṃ pāpamaṃguṣṭhaparimānakaṃ | brahmahatyā śiraskaṃ ca svarṇasteya bhujadvayaṃ ||
madirāpānahṛdayaṃ gurutalpakaṭidvayaṃ | pāpasaṃgapadadvandvamupapātakaloma kiṃ ||
khaḍgacarmadharaṃkruddhamadho vaktrāṃsu duḥsahaṃ |
evaṃ pāpapuruṣaṃ dhyātvā | dakṣāṃguṣṭhena dakṣiṇanāsikāṃ dhṛtvā | yaṃ iti vāyubīja dhūmravarṇa vicintya | tasya ṣoḍaśavāraṃ japan vāmanāsayā vāyumāpūrya pāpapuruṣeṇa sahadehaṃ saṃśoṣya ubhayanāsikāṃ dhṛtvā | raṃ iti vahnibījaṃ raktavarṇaṃ vicintya kuṃbhakaṃ kṛtvā | tasya catuḥṣaṣṭhivāraṃ japan | jātavahninā pāpena sahadehaṃ saṃdahya vaṁ iti varuṇabījaṃ śuklavarṇavicintya | tasya dvātriṃśadvārajapena lalāṭacandrādalita sudhayāmātṛkāvarṇātmikayā tathā tadbhasmarāśiṃ prakṣālyadakṣiṇanāsayā vāyuṃ recayet | tataḥ sohamiti ātmānaṃ devatā mayaṃ
utpannaṃ navīnadehaṃ vicintya jalaṃ iti pṛthivījaṃ pītavarṇaṃ vicintya | tena śarīraṃ sudṛḍhaṃ vibhāvya jīvātmānaṃ kuṃḍalinīṃ caturviṃśati tatvaiḥ saha yathāsthānamānayediti | bhūtaśuddhiḥ |
tato jīvanyāsaṃ kuryāt | lelihāna mudrayā hṛdihastaṃ datvā | āṁ hrīṁ krīṁ haṃ saḥ śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikāyāḥ prāṇā iha prāṇāḥ | oṃ āṁ hrīṁ krīṁ haṃ saḥ śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikāyāḥ jīva iha sthitaḥ | āṁ hrīṁ krīṁ haṃ saḥ śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikāyā sarvendriyāṇi | punaḥ āṁ hrīṁ krīṁ haṃ saḥ śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikāyā vāṅmanonayanaśrotraghrāṇaprāṇā ihāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu svāhā | iti jīvanyāsaḥ |
tataḥ oṃ āṁ hūṁ phaṭ svāhā | iti vyāpakena kāyavākcittaśodhanaṃ kuryāt | oṃ rakṣa (2) hūṁ phaṭ svāhā iti hṛdi hastaṃ datvā ātmarakṣāṃ kuryāt | tata ṛṣyādi nyāsaṃ kuryat |
asya śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikāmantrasya bhairava ṛṣiruṣṇikchandaḥ śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikā devatā hrīṁ bījaṃ hūṁ śaktiḥ klīṁ kīlakaṃ
dharmārthakāmamokṣa caturvargasiddhaye viniyogaḥ ||
iti kṛtāṃjaliḥ paṭhitvā jalaṃ tyaktvā nyaset |
śirasi bhairava ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukheruṣṇikchandase namaḥ | hṛdi śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikā devatāyai namaḥ | guhye hrīṁ bījāya namaḥ | pādayoḥ hūṁ śaktaye namaḥ | sarvāṃge klīṁ kīlakāya namaḥ | dharmārthakāmamokṣa caturvargasiddhaye viniyogaḥ |
tataḥ karāṃganyāsau kuryāt |
oṃ krīṁ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ krīṁ tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ krūṁ madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ | oṃ kraiṁ anāmikābhyāṃ hūṁ | oṃ krauṁ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ | oṃ kraḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ phaṭ | oṃ krīṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ | oṃ krīṁ śirase svāhā | oṃ krūṁ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | oṃ kraiṁ kavacāya hūṁ | oṃ krauṁ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | oṃ kraḥ astrāya phaṭ | phaṭ iti ūrddhvorddha tālatrayaṃ datvā chuṭikābhirdaśadigbaṃdhanaṃ kuryāt |
tato varṇanyāsaṃ kuryāt | aṁ āṁ iṁ īṁ uṁ ūṁ ṛṁ ṝṁ ḷṁ ḹṁ namaḥ hṛdi | dakṣahaste | eṁ aiṁ oṁ auṁ aṁ aḥṁ kaṁ khaṁ gaṁ ghaṁ namaḥ | vāmahaste | ṅaṁ caṁ chaṁ
jaṁ jhaṁ ñaṁ ṭaṁ ṭhaṁ ḍaṁ ḍhaṁ namaḥ | dakṣapāde | ṇaṁ taṁ thaṁ daṁ dhaṁ naṁ paṁ phaṁ baṁ bhaṁ namaḥ | vāmapāde | maṁ yaṁ raṁ laṁ vaṁ śaṁ ṣaṁ saṁ haṁ kṣaṁ namaḥ |
tato mātṛkānyāsaṃ kuryāt |
asya śrīmātṛkāmantrasya brahmā ṛṣirgāyatrīchaṃdo mātṛkā sarasvatīdevatā halo bījāni svarāḥ śaktayaḥ sargaḥ kīlakaṃ mātṛkānyāse viniyogaḥ | śirasi | brahma ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukhe | gāyatrīchaṃdase namaḥ | hṛdi | śrīmātṛkāsarasvatī devatāyai namaḥ | guhye | halobhyo bījebhyo namaḥ | pādayoḥ svarebhyaḥ śaktibhyo namaḥ | sarvāṃge | gargāya kīlakāya namaḥ mātṛkānyāse viniyogaḥ |
mātṛkā karāṃganyāsau yathā |
aṁ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ āṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | iṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ īṃ tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā | uṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ ūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ | eṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ aiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ hūṁ | oṃ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ auṃ kaniṣṭhakābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ | aṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ laṃ kṣaṃ aḥ karakalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ phaṭ | aṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ āṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | iṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ īṃ śirase svāhā |
uṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ ūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | eṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ aiṃ kavacāya hūṁ | oṃ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ auṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | aṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ laṃ kṣaṃ aṃḥ astrāya phaṭ |
athāntarmātṛkā dhyānaṃ |
ādikṣāntamayīṃ navāruṇaruciṃ ṣaṭpadmapatrāsanāṃ nīlāṃbhoruhalocanatrayayutāṃrākābjarūpānanāṃ pīyūṣāṃ śusamāṃ śuguṣṭhamukuṭāṃ vakṣojabhārālasāṃmālāṭaṃkakuraṃgapustakadharāṃ dhyāyentaraṇeśvarīṃ |
evaṃ dhyātvā mānasopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya antarmātṛkāṃ nyaset | kaṃṭhe | viśuddhacakre ṣoḍaśadale aṃ namaḥ āṃ namaḥ iṃ namaḥ īṃ namaḥ uṃ namaḥ ūṃ namaḥ ṛṃ namaḥ ṝṃ namaḥ ḷṃ namaḥ ḹṃ namaḥ eṃ namaḥ aiṃ namaḥ oṃ namaḥ auṃ namaḥ aṃ namaḥ aḥ namaḥ | hṛdaye anāhatacakre dvādaśakale kaṃ namaḥ khaṃ namaḥ gaṃ namaḥ ghaṃ namaḥ ṅaṃ namaḥ caṃ namaḥ chaṃ namaḥ jaṃ namaḥ jhaṃ namaḥ ñaṃ namaḥ ṭaṃ namaḥ ṭhaṃ namaḥ | nābhau maṇipūracakre daśadale ḍaṃ namaḥ ḍhaṃ namaḥ ṇaṃ namaḥ taṃ namaḥ thaṃ namaḥ daṃ namaḥ dhaṃ namaḥ naṃ namaḥ paṃ namaḥ phaṃ namaḥ | liṅge svādhiṣṭhānacakre
ṣaṭdale baṃ namaḥ bhaṃ namaḥ maṃ namaḥ yaṃ namaḥ raṃ namaḥ laṃ namaḥ | mūlādhāre caturdale vaṃ namaḥ śaṃ namaḥ ṣaṃ namaḥ saṃ namaḥ bhruvormadhye ājñācakre dvidale haṃ namaḥ kṣaṃ namaḥ | śirovasthita sahasradalakamalakarṇikāntargata akathādi trikoṇamaṃḍale vāmarekhādi prādakṣiṇyena aṃ namaḥ āṃ namaḥ iṃ namaḥ īṃ namaḥ uṃ namaḥ ūṃ namaḥ ṛṃ namaḥ ṝṃ namaḥ ḷṃ namaḥ ḹṃ namaḥ eṃ namaḥ aiṃ namaḥ oṃ namaḥ auṃ namaḥ aṃ namaḥ aḥ namaḥ ūrdhvarekhāyāṃ kaṃ namaḥ khaṃ namaḥ gaṃ namaḥ ghaṃ namaḥ ṅaṃ namaḥ caṃ namaḥ chaṃ namaḥ jaṃ namaḥ jhaṃ namaḥ ñaṃ namaḥ ṭaṃ namaḥ ṭhaṃ namaḥ ḍaṃ namaḥ ḍhaṃ namaḥ ṇaṃ namaḥ taṃ namaḥ thaṃ namaḥ daṃ namaḥ dhaṃ namaḥ naṃ namaḥ paṃ namaḥ phaṃ namaḥ baṃ namaḥ bhaṃ namaḥ maṃ namaḥ yaṃ namaḥ raṃ namaḥ laṃ namaḥ vaṃ namaḥ śaṃ namaḥ ṣaṃ namaḥ saṃ namaḥ | adhaḥkoṇe haṃ namaḥ vāmakoṇe laṃ namaḥ dakṣakoṇe kṣaṃ namaḥ |
tanmadhye parabinduṃ ca sṛṣṭisthilayātmakaṃ | tenāmṛtena divyena tarpayet parameśvarīṃ ||
evaṃ samāhita manādhyāyennyāso yamāntaraḥ |
atha bahirmātṛkāsṛṣṭidhyānam |
paṃcāśallipibhirvibhaktasukhadoḥ yanmadhyavakṣasthalāṃ bhāsvanmaulini vaddhacandrasakalāmāpīnatuṃgastanīṃ | mudrāmakṣaguṇaṃ sudhāḍhya kalaśaṃ vidyā ca hastāṃbujair vibhrāṇāviśadaprabhāṃ trinayanāṃ vāgdevatāmāśraye ||
evaṃ dhyātvā mānasopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya nyaset |
lalāṭamukhavṛttadakṣavāmanetradvaya karṇadvaya nāsikādvaya gaṃḍadvaya oṣṭhādhara ūrddhvodho dantapaṃkti brahmarandhrajihvākāsu | aṃ namaḥ āṃ namaḥ iṃ namaḥ īṃ namaḥ uṃ namaḥ ūṃ namaḥ ṛṃ namaḥ ṝṃ namaḥ ḷṃ namaḥ ḹṃ namaḥ eṃ namaḥ aiṃ namaḥ oṃ namaḥ auṃ namaḥ aṃ namaḥ aḥ namaḥ | dakṣiṇabāhumūlakūrparamaṇibandha aṃgulimūlāgreṣu | caṃ namaḥ chaṃ namaḥ jaṃ namaḥ jhaṃ namaḥ ñaṃ namaḥ | dakṣiṇa ūrumūlajānusandhigulphāṃgulimūlāgreṣu | ṭaṃ namaḥ ṭhaṃ namaḥ ḍaṃ namaḥ ḍhaṃ namaḥ ṇaṃ namaḥ | vāmorumūlajānusandhigulphāṃgulimūlāgreṣu | taṃ namaḥ thaṃ namaḥ daṃ namaḥ dhaṃ namaḥ naṃ namaḥ |
dakṣavāmapārśvayoḥ | paṃ namaḥ phaṃ namaḥ pṛṣṭhe vaṃ namaḥ nābhau bhaṃ namaḥ jaṭhare maṃ namaḥ hṛdi yaṃ tvagātmane namaḥ | dakṣaskaṃdhe raṃ asṛgātmane namaḥ | kakudi laṃ māṃsātmane namaḥ | vāmaskandhe vaṃ meda ātmane namaḥ | hṛdayādi dakṣahaste śaṃ asthyātmane namaḥ | hṛdayādi vāmahaste ṣaṃ majjātmane namaḥ | hṛdayādi dakṣapāde saṃ śukrātmane namaḥ | hṛdayādi vāmapāde haṃ jīvātmane namaḥ | hṛdayādi jaṭhare laṃ prāṇātmane namaḥ | hṛdayādi mukhe kṣaṃ paramātmane namaḥ | iti sṛṣṭinyāsaḥ |
atha sthitimātṛkādhyānaṃ |
sindūrakāntimamitābharaṇaṃ trinetraṃ vidyākṣasūtra mṛgapotavarāndadhānaṃ | pārśvasthitāṃ bhagavatīmapi kāṃcanāṃgīṃ dhyāyet karābjadhṛtapustakavarṇamālāṃ ||
evaṃ dhyātvā mānasopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya | dakṣagulphādi dakṣajānuparyantaṃ | ḍakārādi vakārāntān varṇān mātṛkāsthāne nyaset tadyathā | dakṣagulphe | ḍaṃ namaḥ tadaṃgulimūlāgrayoḥ
ḍhaṃ namaḥ ṇaṃ namaḥ vāmorujānusandhi gulphāpādāṃgulimūlāgreṣu | taṃ namaḥ thaṃ namaḥ daṃ namaḥ dhaṃ namaḥ naṃ namaḥ | dakṣavāmapārśvayoḥ | paṃ namaḥ phaṃ namaḥ pṛṣṭhe vaṃ namaḥ | nābhijaṭharayoḥ | bhaṃ namaḥ maṃ namaḥ | hṛdayaṃ tvagātmane namaḥ | dakṣaskaṃdhe raṃ asṛgātmane namaḥ | kakudi laṃ māṃsātmane namaḥ | vāmaskaṃdhe vaṃ meda ātmane namaḥ | hṛdādidakṣahaste śaṃ asthyātmane namaḥ | hṛdādi vāmahaste ṣaṃ majjātmane namaḥ | hṛdādi dakṣapāde śaṃ śukrātmane namaḥ | hṛdādi vāmapāde haṃ jīvātmane namaḥ | hṛdādi jaṭhare laṃ prāṇātmane namaḥ | hṛdādi mukhe kṣaṃ paramātmane namaḥ | lalāṭamukhavṛttadakṣavāmanetra tathā karṇadvaya nāsikādvaya gaṃḍadvaya oṣṭhādhara ūrddhādho daṃtapaṃkti brahmaraṃdhra jihvāsu | aṃ namaḥ āṃ namaḥ iṃ namaḥ īṃ namaḥ uṃ namaḥ ūṃ namaḥ ṛṃ namaḥ ṝṃ namaḥ ḷṃ namaḥ ḹṃ namaḥ eṃ namaḥ aiṃ namaḥ oṃ namaḥ auṃ namaḥ aṃ namaḥ aḥ namaḥ dakṣavāhumūlakūrparamaṇibaṃdha hastāṃgulimūlāgreṣu | kaṃ namaḥ khaṃ namaḥ gaṃ namaḥ ghaṃ namaḥ ṅaṃ namaḥ | vāmabāhumūlakūrparamaṇibaṃdhakarāṅgulimūlāgreṣu |
caṃ namaḥ chaṃ namaḥ jaṃ namaḥ jhaṃ namaḥ ñaṃ namaḥ | dakṣorumūlajānunoḥ | ṭaṃ namaḥ ṭhaṃ namaḥ | iti sthitimātṛkānyāsaḥ ||
atha saṃhāramātṛkādhyānaṃ |
akṣasrajaṃ hariṇapotamudagraṭaṃkaṃ vidyāṃ karairavirataṃ dadhatīṃ trinetrāṃ | ardhendu maulimaruṇāmaravindarāmāvarṇeśvarīṃ praṇamatastanabhāranamrāṃ ||
iti dhyātvā mānasopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya nyaset |
kṣakārādi akārāṃtān varṇānmukhādi lalāṭānta sthāneṣu nyaset tadyathā | hṛdādimukhe kṣaṃ paramātmane namaḥ | hṛdādijaṭhare laṃ prāṇātmane namaḥ | hṛdādivāmapāde haṃ jīvātmane namaḥ | hṛdādidakṣapāde saṃ śukrātmane namaḥ | hṛdādivāmahaste ṣaṃ majjātmane namaḥ | hṛdādi dakṣahaste śaṃ asthyātmane namaḥ | vāmaskandhe vaṃ medātmane namaḥ | kakudi laṃ māṃsātmane namaḥ | dakṣaskaṃdhe raṃ asṛgātmane namaḥ | hṛdayaṃ tvagātmane namaḥ | jaṭharanābhipṛṣṭhavāmadakṣiṇapārśveṣu maṃ namaḥ bhaṃ namaḥ vaṃ namaḥ phaṃ namaḥ paṃ namaḥ | vāmapādāṃgulyagramūlagulphajānusandhi urumūleṣu | naṃ namaḥ dhaṃ namaḥ daṃ namaḥ thaṃ namaḥ taṃ namaḥ | dakṣapādāṃgulyagramūlagulphajānusandhi
urumūleṣu | ṇaṃ namaḥ ḍhaṃ namaḥ ḍaṃ namaḥ ṭhaṃ namaḥ ṭaṃ namaḥ | vāmahastāṃgulyagramūlamaṇibandhabāhumūleṣu | ñaṃ namaḥ jhaṃ namaḥ jaṃ namaḥ chaṃ namaḥ caṃ namaḥ | dakṣahastāṃgulyagramūlamaṇibaṃdhakūrparabāhumūleṣu | ṅaṃ namaḥ ghaṃ namaḥ gaṃ namaḥ khaṃ namaḥ kaṃ namaḥ | jihvā brahmaraṃdhra adha urddhvadantapaṃkti adharauṣṭhavāmadakṣagaṃḍadvaya tathā nāsikādvaya karṇadvaya netradvaya mukhavṛttalalāṭeṣu | aḥ namaḥ aṃ namaḥ auṃ namaḥ oṃ namaḥ aiṃ namaḥ eṃ namaḥ ḹṃ namaḥ ḷṃ namaḥ ṝṃ namaḥ ṛṃ namaḥ ūṃ namaḥ uṃ namaḥ īṃ namaḥ iṃ namaḥ āṃ namaḥ aṃ namaḥ | iti saṃhāramātṛkānyāsaḥ ||
gṛhasthaḥ punaḥ sṛṣṭisthitīnyāsau kuryyāt | praṇāmantantrāntare paṃcadhā mātṛkā nyāsaḥ | sṛṣṭisthitiśca saṃhṛti | punaḥ sṛṣṭisthitī kuryādevaṃ paṃcavidhaḥ smṛtaḥ gautamīyepi |
saṃhṛtirdoṣa saṃhānāṃ hāriṇī parikīrtitā | vidyāpradaśca sṛṣṭyanto varṇināṃ śuddha cetasāṃ ||
sthityantaḥsyāgṛhasthānāṃ trayaṃ kāmyānurūpataḥ | sahajānau vānaprasthe sthityantaḥ kaścidicchati ||
saṃhārānto munīnāṃ ca viraktasya ca sarvaśaḥ |
nyāsatrayaṃ sadākāryamaśaktāmekameva hi ||
kecit tu sarvavarṇāśrameṣu | paṃcadhā vinyasedvāpi tridhāvāpi ca vinyasediti | kāmyādi pūjāyāmatra śrīkaṃṭhādi mātṛkānyāsaḥ | ṣoḍhānyāsau vidheyau kintu bāhulya bhayādannaṃ na likhitau |
atha sāmānyabījaṣoḍhānyāsau |
yathā | śirasi oṃ namaḥ bhruvormadhye | oṃ hrīṁ strīṁ hūṁ phaṭ namaḥ kaṇṭhe | eṃ namaḥ | hṛdi klīṁ namaḥ | nābhau aiṃ namaḥ | liṃge klīṁ namaḥ | guhye sauṃ namaḥ | dakṣahaste hūṁ namaḥ | vāmahaste śrīṁ namaḥ | dakṣapāde hrīṁ namaḥ | vāmapāde klīṁ namaḥ | pṛṣṭhe krīṁ namaḥ | iti tataḥ sakalāyāṃ vidyāyāṃ tatvanyāsa bījanyāsau karttavyau tadyathā | nābhyādi hṛdayānnaṃ dakṣiṇe kālike oṃṁ vidyātatvāya namaḥ | hṛdādi brahmaraṃdhrāntaṃ | krīṁ krīṁ krīṁ hūṁ hūṁ hrīṁ hrīṁ kuryāt | brahmarandhre krīṁ namaḥ | bhruvormadhye krīṁ namaḥ | lalāṭe krīṁ namaḥ | nābhau hūṁ namaḥ | guhye hūṁ namaḥ | mukhe hrīṁ namaḥ | sarvāṃge hrīṁ namaḥ | iti bījanyāsaḥ ||
tato mūlamaṃtreṇa śīrṣādi pādaparyaṃtaṃ pādādi śirontaṃ
saptadhā mukhādi jaṭharāntaṃ jaṭharādimukhāntaṃ saptadhā vyastahastābhyāṃ vyāpaka nyāsaṃ kuryāt |
tataḥ oṃ hrīṁ mūlaṃ hrīṁ iti saptadhā saptachadāṃ japet | tataḥ pīṭhanyāsaṃ kuryāt | hṛtpadma karṇikāyāṃ oṃ ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ | oṃ prakṛtyai namaḥ | evaṃ kamaṭhāya śeṣāya pṛthvisudhāṃbudhaye maṇidvīpāya ciṃtāmaṇigṛhāya śmaśānāya pārijātāya tanmūle oṃ ratnavedikāyai namaḥ | tasyopari oṃ maṇipīṭhāya namaḥ | caturdikṣu oṃ munibhyo namaḥ | evaṃ devebhyo namaḥ | śavamuṃḍebhyo namaḥ | dakṣaskaṃdhe oṃ dharmāya namaḥ | vāmaskaṃdhe jñānāya namaḥ | vāmorau oṃ vairāgyāya namaḥ | dakṣapārśve oṃ anaiśvaryāya namaḥ | sarvatra praṇavādi namontena nyaset | punaḥ karṇikāyāṃ | aṃ anaṃtāya namaḥ | paṃ padmāya namaḥ | āṃ ānaṃdāya namaḥ | saṃ saṃvinnālāya namaḥ | paṃ prakṛtimaya patrebhyo namaḥ | viṃ vikāramaya keśarebhyo namaḥ | taṃ tatvarūpakarṇikāyai namaḥ | aṃ arkamaṃḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ |
oṃ somamaṃḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ | maṃ vahnimaṃḍalāya daśakalātmane namaḥ | saṃ satvāya namaḥ | raṃ rajase namaḥ | taṃ tamase namaḥ | āṃ ātmane namaḥ | aṃ aṃtarātmane namaḥ | paṃ paramātmane namaḥ | hrīṁ jñānātmane namaḥ |
tato hṛtpadmakeśareṣu pūrvāditaḥ prādakṣiṇyena pīṭhaśaktirnyaset | oṃ icchāyai namaḥ | oṃ jñānāyai namaḥ | oṃ kriyāyai namaḥ | oṃ kāminyai namaḥ | oṃ kāmadāyinyai namaḥ | oṃ ratyai namaḥ | oṃ ratipriyāyai namaḥ | oṃ ānaṃdāyai namaḥ | madhye maṃ manonmanyai namaḥ | tadupari aiṃ parāyai aparāyai parāparāyai hsauḥ sadāśiva mahāpretapadmāsanāya namaḥ | iti pīṭhanyāsaḥ ||
tataḥ prāṇāyāmaṃ ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ kṛtvā devīṃ dhyāyet | dhyānaṃ yathā |
karālavadanāṃ ghorāṃ muktakeśīṃ caturbhujāṃ | kālikāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ divyāṃ muṃḍamālāvibhūṣitāṃ ||
sadyaśchinnaśiraḥ khaḍga vāmādhorddhva karāṃbujāṃ |
abhayaṃ varadaṃ caiva dakṣiṇorddhvādha pāṇikāṃ ||
mahāmeghaprabhāṃ śyāmāṃ tathā caiva digaṃbarāṃ | kaṃṭhāvasaktamuṃḍālī galadrudhira carcitāṃ ||
karṇāvataṃ satāṃnīta śavayugmabhayānakāṃ | ghoradaṃṣṭrā karālāsyāṃ pīnonnata payodharāṃ ||
sarvālaṃkārabhūṣāṃgī sarvāśubha vināśinī | śavānāṃ karasaṃghātaiḥ kṛta kāṃcī hasanmukhīṃ ||
sṛkkadvayagaladrakta dhārāvisphuritānanāṃ | ghorarāvāṃ mahāraudrīṃ śmaśānālayavāsinīṃ ||
bālārkamaṃḍalākāra locanatritayānvitāṃ | danturāṃ dakṣiṇavyāpi muktālaṃbika coccayāṃ ||
śavarūpa mahādeva hṛdayoparisaṃsthitāṃ | śivābhirghorarāvābhiścaturdikṣu samanvitāṃ ||
madirāghūrṇanayanāṃ lalajjihvāṭṭahāsinīm | mahākālena ca samaṃ viparīta etāturāṃ ||
sukhaprasannanayanāṃ smerānana saroruhāṃ ||
nāgayajñopavītāṃgī candrārdhakṛtaśekharāṃ | evaṃ saṃciṃtayet kālīṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadāṃ ||
dhyānānaṃtaraṃ yathā |
aṃjanādri nibhāṃ devīṃ karālavadanā śivāṃ | muṃḍamālāvatīramyāṃ muktakeśī smitānanāṃ ||
mahākāla hṛdāṃbhoja sthitāṃ pītapayodharāṃ | viparītaratāsaktāṃ ghoradaṃṣṭrāṃ śivaiḥ saha ||
nāgayajñopavītāṃ ca candrārddhakṛtaśekharāṃ | sarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktāṃ muktāmaṇivibhūṣitāṃ ||
mṛtahasta sahasraistu baddhakāṃcīṃ digaṃbarāṃ | śivākoṭisahasraistu yoginībhirvirājitāṃ ||
raktapānamukhāṃbhojāṃ madhupānapramattikāṃ | vahnyarka śaśi netrāṃ ca raktavisphuritānanāṃ ||
vigatāsu kiśorābhyāṃ kṛtakarṇāvataṃsinīṃ | kaṃṭhāvasaktamuṃḍāli galadrudhira carcitāṃ ||
śmaśānaṃ vahnimadhyasthāṃ brahmakeśava vanditāṃ | sadyaḥkṛta śiraḥkhaḍga varābhītikarāṃbujāṃ ||
dhyānāntaraṃ yathā |
bhinnāṃjana ca ya prakhyāṃ pravīnaśavasaṃsthitāṃ | galacchoṇitadhārābhi smerānana sarorūhāṃ ||
pīnonnata kucadvandvāṃ pīnavakṣo nitaṃbinīṃ | dakṣiṇāṃ muktakeśāli digaṃbara vinodinīṃ ||
mahākāla śavāviṣṭāṃ smerānandoparisthitāṃ | āraktamukhanetrābhiryoginībhivirājitāṃ ||
śavadvayakṛtontaṃsāṃ sindūratilakojjvalāṃ |
paṃcāśanmuṃḍaghaṭitaṃ mālāśoṇita lohitāṃ ||
nānāmaṇiviśobhāḍhyāṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitāṃ | śavāsthi kṛtakeyūraṃ śaṃkhakaṃkaṇamaṃḍitāṃ ||
śavavakṣaḥ samāsīnāṃ lelihānāṃ śavaṃ kvacit | śavamāṃsakṛtagrāsāṃ sāṭṭahāsāṃ muhurmuhuḥ ||
khaḍgamuṃḍadharāṃ vāme dakṣe bhayavarapradāṃ | daṃturāṃ ca mahāraudrīṃ caṃḍanādāti bhīṣaṇāṃ ||
śivābhirghorārāvābhirveṣṭitāṃ bhayanāśinīṃ | mābhai mābhaiḥ svabhaktebhyo jalpaṃtī ghoraniḥsvanaiḥ ||
yūyaṃ kimichathavaraṃ dadāmīti prabhāṣiṇīṃ ||
dhyānāṃtaraṃ ||
sadyaśchinnaśiraḥ kṛpāṇamabhayaṃ hastairvaraṃ vibhratīṃ ghorāsyāṃ śirasaḥ srajāṃ surucirāmunmuktakeśāvalīṃ | sṛkkāsṛkpravahāṃ śmaśānanitapāṃśrutyośavāṃlaṃkṛtīṃ śyāmāṃgīkṛtamekhalāṃ śavakarairdevīṃ bhaje kālikāṃ ||
dhyānāṃtaraṃ ||

tatra trikoṇavṛtta ṣaṭkoṇamaṃḍalaṃ vilikhya ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṃgāni saṃpūjya mūlena trikoṇaṃ saṃpūjya | vṛttopari pūrvāditaḥ prādakṣiṇyena vahnerdaśakalāḥ pūjayet | yaṃ dhūmrārciṣe namaḥ | raṃ ūṣmāyai namaḥ | laṃ jvalinyai namaḥ | vaṃ jvālinyai namaḥ | śaṃ visphuliṃginyai namaḥ | ṣaṃ suśriyai namaḥ | saṃsurūpīyai namaḥ | haṃ kapilāyai namaḥ | laṃ havyavahāyai namaḥ | kṣaṃ kavyavahāyai namaḥ | tadupari maṃ vahnimaṃḍalāya daśakalātmane namaḥ | iti saṃpūjya | phaṭ iti mahāśaṃkhādipātraṃ prakṣālya namaḥ | iti ādhāroparisaṃsthāpya |
tatra trikoṇavṛtta ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vilikhya | ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṃgāni mūlena trikoṇaṃ saṃpūjya vṛttopari pūrvavat | sūryasya dvādaśakalāḥ pūjayet | kaṃ bhaṃ tapinyai namaḥ | khaṃ vaṃ tāpinyai namaḥ | gaṃ phaṃ
dhūmrāyai namaḥ | ghaṃ paṃ marīcyai namaḥ | ṅaṃ naṃ jvālinyai namaḥ | caṃ dhaṃ rucyai namaḥ | chaṃ daṃ suṣumnāyai namaḥ | jaṃ thaṃ bhogadāyai namaḥ | jhaṃ taṃ viśvāyai namaḥ | ñaṃ ṇaṃ bodhinyai namaḥ | ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ dhāriṇyai namaḥ | ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ kṣamāyai namaḥ | tadupari aṃ arkkamaṃḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ | iti saṃpūjya kṣakārādi akārāṃtāṃ vilomamātṛkāṃ mūlamaṃtraṃ coccāryaghaṭastha kāraṇena śrīpātraṃ tribhāgamāpūrya śeṣaṃ jalenāpūrya tatra trikoṇavṛtta ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vilikhya | ṣaṭkoṇeṣu ṣaḍaṃgāni mūlena trikoṇaṃ saṃpūjya | vṛttopari pūrvavat | caṃdrasya ṣoḍaśakalāḥ pūjayet | aṃ amṛtāyai namaḥ | āṃ mānadāyai namaḥ | iṃ pūṣāyai namaḥ | īṃ tuṣṭyai namaḥ | uṃ puṣṭyai namaḥ | ūṃ ratyai namaḥ | ṛṃ dhṛtyai namaḥ | ṝṃ śaśinyai namaḥ | ḷṃ caṃdrikāyai namaḥ | ḹṃ kāṃtyai namaḥ | eṃ jyotsnāyai namaḥ | aiṃ śriyai namaḥ | oṃ prītyai namaḥ | auṃ aṃgāyai namaḥ | aṃ pūrṇāyai namaḥ | aṃḥ pūrṇāmṛtāyai namaḥ | tadupari uṃ somamaṃḍalāya ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ | iti saṃpūjya ||
tatra kroṃ gaṃge cetyādināṃkuśamudrayā caṃdramaṃḍalāttīrthamāvāhya | raktapuṣpaśvetaraktacaṃdanadūrvākṣatān tatra nikṣipya mūlena śuddhi mīnamudrā kulakusumāni kiṃcit tatra nikṣipya pūrvavat | akathādi śaktimaṃḍalaṃ tatra vilikhya | hsauḥ maṃḍalāya namaḥ | iti maṃḍalaṃ saṃpūjya |
tatra pūrvavat ānaṃdabhairavaṃ | ānaṃdabharavīṃ ca dhyātvā pūjayet |
tataḥ śrīpātraṃ dhṛtvā abhimaṃtrayedebhirmaṃtraiḥ aiṃ klīṃ sauṃḥ
brahmāṃḍarasasaṃbhūtamaśeṣarasasaṃbhavaṃ | āpūritaṃ mahāpātraṃ pīyūṣarasamāvahaṃ ||
aiṃ akhaṃḍaikarasānaṃdakare parasudhātmani svachandasphuraṇā maṃtra nidhehi kularūpiṇī |
klīṁ akulasthāmṛtākāre śuddhajñānakalevare | amṛtatvaṃ nidhe hyasmin vastuni klinnarūpiṇi ||
sauḥ tadrūpeṇaikarasyaṃ ca kṛtvā syaika svarūpiṇi | bhūtvā kulāmṛtākāraṃ mayi viṣkaraṇaṃ kuru ||
oṃ asantāpātra bhavitāmidantā paramāmṛtaṃ | parāhaṃtāmaye vahnau homa
svīkāralakṣaṇaṃ | aiṁ vada vada vāgvādini klīṃ klinne kledini kledaya (2) hsauḥ mahākṣobhaṃ kuru kuru hsauṃḥ mahāmokṣaṃ kuru (2) svāhā | glūṁ slūṁ nlūṁ plūṁ mlūṁ amṛte amṛtodbhave amṛteśvari amṛtavarṣiṇi mahāprakāśayukte amṛtaṃ srāvaya (2) svāhā |
tataḥ śrīpātre paṃcaratnāni pūjayet | glūṁ gaganarantebhyo namaḥ | slūṃ svargaratnebhyo namaḥ | plūṃ pātālaratnebhyo namaḥ | mlūṃ martyaratnebhyo namaḥ |
tataḥ punastatra ānaṃdabhairavaṃ ānaṃdabhairavīṃ ca pūjayet | tatastatra sveṣṭa devīmāvāhya huṃ iti avaguṃṭhya vaṃ dhenumudrayā amṛtīkṛtya mūlena yonimudrayā saṃdīpya | ṣaḍaṃgaiḥ sakalīkṛtya matsyamudrayā āchādya tatra mūlamaṃtraṃ daśadhā japtvā devīrūpaṃ śrīpātraṃ vibhāvya | gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpaistatra devīṃ saṃpūjya | tenodakenātmānaṃ pūjopakaraṇānyabhyukṣayet | iti śrīpātrasthāpanaṃ ||
tato gurvādi pātrāṇi sthāpayet | ghaṭasamīpe gurupātraṃ tato bhogapātraṃ | tataḥ śaktipātraṃ |
tato yoginīpātraṃ | tato vīrapātraṃ | tato balipātraṃ | tataḥ pādyapātraṃ | tata ācamanīpātraṃ | śrīpātreṇa navapātrāṇi bhavaṃti | tadabhāve śrīpātraṃ gurupātraṃ bhoga śakti yoginī vīra bali saptapātrāṇi | tadabhāve śrīgurubhogayoginī bali paṃcapātrāṇi | tadabhāve śrīgurubhoga tripātrāṇi | eṣāṃ sthāpana kramo yathā | bhūmau trikoṇavṛtta caturasramaṃḍalāni saṃpūjya | phaṭ iti sādhāraṇa pātrāṇi prakṣālya namaḥ | iti maṃḍaloparisaṃsthāpya kāraṇenāpūrya ādhārapātrā | tīrtheṣu vahni sūryaśaśimaṃḍalāni saṃpūjya | tatra śuddhi mīnamudrayā kulakusumāni nikṣipya hūṃ iti avaguṃṭhya | vaṃ dhenumudrayā amṛtīkṛtya mūlena yonimudrayā saṃdīpya | ṣaḍaṃgaiḥ sakalīkṛtya | matsyamudrayā āchādya | tatra mūlamaṃtraṃ daśadhā japediti | tatastarpaṇaṃ kuryāt | yathā vāmahastatatvamudrayā | śrīpātrasthakāraṇaṃ śuddhyādi sahitaṃ gṛhītvā
śirasi sahakṣamalavarayūṃ ānaṃdabhairavāya vaṣaṭ | etatsaśuddhyā savaṃ ānaṃdabhairavaṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ | iti trivāraṃ saṃtarpya sahakṣamalavarayīṃ ānaṃdabhairavyai vaṣaṭ | etat saśuddhyā savaṃ ānaṃdabhairavīṃ tarpayāmi svāhā | iti trivāraṃ tarpayet |
tato gurupātrāmṛtena evaṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ amukānaṃdanātha śrī amukīdevyaṃvā śrīpādukāṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ | iti triḥ | tato aiṃ śrīṃ guruṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ | aiṃ paramaguruṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ | aiṃ parāparaguruṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ | aiṃ parameṣṭhiguruṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ | śrīpātrāmṛtena oṃ devāṃstarpayāmi namaḥ | oṃ ṛṣīṃstarpayāmi namaḥ | oṃ pitṝṃstarpayāmi namaḥ | iti sakṛta sakṛta tarpayet | tataḥ śrīpātrāmṛtena mūlamūcārya etat saśuddhyāsavaṃ śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikāṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ svāhā | iti saptapaṃcatridhā vā tarpayet | tato bhogapātrāmṛtena mahākālamaṃtramuccārya | etat saśuddhyāsavaṃ śrīmanmahākālabhairavaṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ | iti tristarpayet |
tataḥ śaktipātrāmṛtena yoginī
pātrāmṛtena vā mūlamuccārya etat saśuddhyāsavaṃ sāyudhāṃ savāhanāṃ saparivārāṃ śrīmanmahākālabhairavasahitāṃ śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikāṃ tarpayāmi svāhā | iti trivāraṃ tarpayediti tarpaṇaṃ | tatastatvaśuddhiṃ kuryāt | kṛtāṃjaliḥ oṃ prāṇāpāna samānodānavyānā me śuddhyatāṃ jyotirahaṃ virajāvipāpmā bhūyāsaṃ svāhā || 1 ||
oṃ pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśāni me śuddhyaṃtāṃmityādi || 2 || oṃ prakṛtyahaṃkārabuddhimanaḥśrotrāṇi me śuddhyaṃtāmityādi || 3 || oṃ tvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇavacāṃsi me śuddhyaṃtāmityādi || 4 || oṃ pāṇipādapāyūpasthaśabdā me śuddhyaṃtāmityādi || 5 || oṃ sparśarūparasagaṃdhākāśani me śuddhyatāmityādi ||
iti sapta ṛgbhiravamṛṣyakāraṇena karatale saṃmārjya dakṣiṇahastatale adhomukha trikoṇaṃ vilikhya trikoṇeṣu madhye ca śuddhi khaṃḍāni saṃsthāpya mūlamaṃtrāṃte hrīṁ śrīṁ ātmatatvena sthūladehaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā | ityanena bhagamudrayā adhasthāṃ śuddhiṃ svīkuryāt | mūlāṃte hrīṁ śrīṁ vidyātatvena sūkṣmadehaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā | ityanena
dakṣiṇasthāṃ śuddhiṃ svīkuryāt | mūlāṃte hrīṁ śrīṁ śivatatvena paradehaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā | ityanena vāmasthāṃ śuddhiṃ svīkuryāt | mūlānte hrīṁ śrīṁ sarvatatvena tanu tatrayāśrayaṃ jīvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā | ityanena madhyasthāṃ śuddhiṃ svīkuryāditi tatvaśuddhiḥ | tato bhogapātra tatvamudrayā trivāraṃ biṃdū svīkāraṃ kuryāt yathā | mūlaṃ ārdraṃ jvalati jyotihamasmi jyotirjvalani brahmāhamasmi ahamasmi brahmāhamasmi yohamasmi sohamasmi brahmāhamasmi ahameva hi māṃ juhomi svāhā || 1 ||
mūlaṃ tvameva pratyakṣaṃ brahmāsitvāmeva prakṣaṃ vadiṣyāmi tvaṃ māmavatu tvadvaktāramavatu āvatu māmavatu vaktāraṃ svāhā || 2 ||
mūlaṃ paraśchaṃdaśāmṛṣabho viśvarūpaśchaṃdobhyodhyamṛtātsaṃvabhūva samendomedhayā spṛṇoti amṛtasya devadhāraṇo bhūyāsaṃ śarīre me vicarṣaṇaṃ jihvā me madhumattamākarṇābhyāṃ bhūri viśruvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kośosi medhayā pihita śrutaṃ me gopāya svāhā || 3 ||
iti maṃtratrayeṇa trivāraṃ vidu svīkuryāt | tato vaṭukādibhyo baliṃ dadyāt |
siṃhāsanasya pūrvādidikṣu trikoṇavṛtta caturasramaṃḍalaṃ catuṣṭayaṃ nirmāya | athavā svavāme tanmaṃḍalaṃmekaṃ nirmāya phaṭ iti arghyodakena saṃprokṣya ete gaṃdhapuṣpe | oṃ maṃḍalāya nama iti maṇḍalaṃ saṃpūjya tatra māṃsamīnamudrā balipātra kāraṇādi sahita balicatuṣṭayaṃ saṃsthāpya pūrve ete gaṃdhapuṣpe vāṃ vaṭukāya namaḥ | iti vaṭukaṃ saṃpūjya vāmahasta tatvamudrayā baliṃ dhṛtvā | dakṣiṇe navapātrakāraṇaṃ arghyodakaṃ vā gṛhītvā balimutsṛjet | ehi ehi devī puṭavaṭukanātha kapilajaṭābhāra bhāsvara trinetra jvālāmukha sarvavighnānnāśaya nāśaya baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa svāhā | eṣa balirvaṭukanāthāya namaḥ | dakṣiṇe yāṃ yoginībhyo namaḥ | iti saṃpūjya dakṣiṇahastāṃguṣṭhonāmikābhyāṃ baliṃ vāmahastena kāraṇaṃ jalaṃ vā gṛhītvā balimutsṛjedanena urddhe brahmāṃḍato vā divigaganatale bhūtale niṣkale vā pātāle vā vane vā salilapavanayoryatra kutra sthitā
vā kṣetre pīṭhopapīṭhādiṣu ca kṛtaparā dhūpadīpādikena prītā devyaḥ sadānaḥ śubha bali vidhinā pāṃtu vīrendravaṃdyāḥ | yāṃ yoginībhyaḥ svāhā | sarvayoginībhyo huṃ phaṭ svāhā | eṣa baliryoginībhyo namaḥ | paścime kṣāṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ | iti pūrvavat saṃpūjya vāmamuṣṭikṛta tarjanīśaralīkṛtya baliṃ dhṛtvā utsṛjet | anena
triśūlaṃ ḍamarūṃ caiva kapālaṃ śaṃkhameva ca | dadhānaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāṃtaṃ bhajehaṃ kṣetrapālakaṃ ||
kṣāṃ kṣīṃ kṣūṃ kṣaiṃ kṣauṃ kṣaḥ sthānakṣetrapāla dhūpadīpādisahitaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇa (2) svāhā | eṣa bali kṣetrapālāya namaḥ | uttare gāṃ gaṇeśāya namaḥ | iti gaṇeśaṃ saṃpūjya vāmamuṣṭi madhyamāṃguṣṭhaśaralayogādbalimutsṛjedanena | gāṃ gīṃ gūṃ gaiṃ gauṃ gaḥ gaṇapataye varada sarvaganaṃ me vaśamānaya baliṃ gṛhṇa (2) svāhā | eṣa balirgaṇeśāya namaḥ | tataḥ svavāme caturasraṃ maṃḍalaṃ vilikhya | phaṭ iti maṃḍalaṃ saṃprokṣya | oṃ vyāpakamaṃḍalāya iti saṃpūjya |
tatra pūrvavadbali saṃsthāpya | ete gaṃdhapuṣpe hrīṃ śrīṃ
sarvavighnakṛdbhyaḥ sarvabhūtebhyo hūṃ phaṭ svāhā | eṣa baliḥ sarvabhūtebhyo namaḥ | paṃcabalidāne aśaktaścet sarvabhūtebhyo balimekaṃ dadyāt | iti balidānavidhiḥ |
tataḥ prāṇāyāmaṃ ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ ca kṛtvā kāmakalārūpamātmānaṃ bhāvayet | kāmakalābījaṃ tu īṃ asyā dhyānaṃ viciṃtayet suṃdarīṃ devīṃ sarvavyāpakarūpiṇīṃ | ikārabhūtamaṃtaḥ sthāvayavaṃ caṃ catuṣṭayaṃ |
biṃdutrayeṇa deveśi prathamaṃ devi vaktrakaṃ | biṃdudvayaṃ stanadvaṃdvaṃ hṛdisthāne niyojayet ||
hakārārdhakalāṃ sūkṣmāṃ yonimadhye viciṃtayet | tathā kāmakalārūpāṃ madanāṃkura gocarāṃ ||
udyadādityasaṃkāśāṃ siṃdūrābhāṃ stanadvayaṃ | biṃdusaṃkalpya vaktre tu sphuraddīpaśikhāṃ priye ||
ādhārādbrahmaraṃdhrāṃtaṃ taṃtramārgeṇa bhāvayet | kāmo biṃdurahaṃ devi tatrasthā parameśvarī ||
śivaśaktimayaṃ devi tadadhasthāt kucadvayaṃ | tadadhaḥ saparārddhaṃ ca cidrūpāṃ paramāṃ kalāṃ ||
sāpi kuṃḍalinī śaktiḥ kāmakalāsvarūpiṇī | sāpi ca trividhā sṛṣṭirbrahmaviṣṇuśivātmikā ||
tāṃ ciṃtyasādhaka śreṣṭhastrailokyaṃ vaśamānayet | śaktyabhāve mahāśaktirmahāṃsiddhipradāyinīṃ ||
evaṃ kāmakalārūpamātmānaṃ viciṃtya | pūrvavaddevīṃ dhyātvā | mūlādhārastha kuṃḍalinīṃ ṣaṭcakrabhedakrameṇa sahasrāre nītvā tatrastha paramaśive saṃyojya tatraiva kṣaṇamātraṃ ramayitvā tadudbhavāmṛtenāplāvya ānaṃdalolībhūtāṃ brahmamayīṃ hṛdayāṣṭadale samānīya śvāsamārgeṇa dīpāddīpāntaramiva karasthamātṛkāṃ bhojasvarūpa puṣpāṃjalāvānīya tatpuṣpaṃ yaṃtrādau saṃsthāpya mūlamaṃtreṇa devīmūrttiṃ saṃkalpya kṛtāṃjaliḥ |
oṃ deveśi bhaktisulabhe parivārasamanvite | yāvat tvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi tāvat tvāṃ susthirā bhava ||
iti saṃprārthya āvāhayet |
paṃcamudrābhiryathā | bhagavati śrīmaddakṣiṇakālike sāyudhe savāhane saparivāre śrīmanmahākālabhairava sahite ihāgaccha iha tiṣṭha iha sannidhai hi iha sannirūddhasva iha saṃmukhī bhava |
kṛtāṃjaliḥ | atrādhiṣṭhānaṃ kuru mama pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa | tato lelihānamudrayā yaṃtraṃ dhṛtvā prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kuryāt | yathā āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ haṃ saḥ śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikāyāḥ prāṇā iha prāṇāḥ punaḥ āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ haṃ saḥ śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikāyāḥ jīva iha sthitaḥ āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ haṃ saḥ śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikāyāḥ sarvendriyāṇi āṃ hrīṃ kroṃ haṃ saḥ śrīmaddakṣiṇakālikāyā vāṅmanonayanaśrotra ghrāṇa prāṇā ihāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu svāhā | tatorghyodakena mātṛkāṃ biṃduyuktāṃ mūlamaṃtraṃ coccāryya devīṃ saṃprokṣya paramīkaraṇī mahāmudrāṃ pradarśya | hūṃ iti avaguṃṭhya dhenumudrayā amṛtīkṛtya mūlena yonimudrayā saṃdīpya mahāyonibhūtinī mudre pradarśya ṣaḍaṃgamaṃtraiḥ sakalīkṛtya pūjayet | pūjā tu ṣoḍaśopacārā yathā |
āsanaṃ svāgataṃ pādyamarghyamācamanīyakaṃ | madhuparkācamanasnānaṃ vasanābharaṇāni ca ||
gaṃdhapuṣpadhūpadīpanaivedyacandanāni ca |
prayojayedarcanāyāmupacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśa ||
pādyārghyācamanīyāni madhuparkācamanaṃ tathā | gaṃdhādayo naivedyāntā upacārā daśa kramāt ||
